ORIGINAL WORLDS · ORIGINAL MISCHIEF

Hold ◀ / ▶ with your left thumb. Tap the game to hit. Swipe up to jump, down to crouch or enter a passage; keep your finger down to hold the action. Full screen is available in the game toolbar.

01 / THE ADVENTURE

A club. A caveman.
A very big appetite.

Leap through the wild, give the local wildlife a gentle whack, and uncover a feast of hidden treasures. Find the key, open the exit, and keep the adventure going.
